_comment: Second descriptor for layout/bin/pex-netlist.py -- the SAMPLER side of
the post-layout library, sibling to pex.json (the entropy-source side).
Same script, same schema, same --check contract; a separate descriptor
rather than more cells[] entries in pex.json because pex.json's output
file is named ro_ring5_pex.spice and every sim/ record already minted
from it carries that path plus its sha256 in its own `netlists` block.
Renaming it (or growing it with cells no ring deck instantiates) would
invalidate that provenance for a naming convenience.
The three cells below are exactly the leaf shapes
design/sampler_core.spice's flat `.subckt sampler_dff` reduces to:
3 x inverter (XMpc/XMnc, XMim2p/XMim2n, XMisp/XMisn), 4 x transmission
gate (TG_D, TG_FBM, TG_S, TG_FBS) and 2 x NAND2 (NAND_M, NAND_S2) --
22 devices, the same 22 that subckt lists. Every one of them is a
composed cell under layout/ that is `klt drc` clean (0 violations) and
`klt lvs` matching its own reference netlist.
sampler_inv_pex   layout/ro_buf/ -- the plain CMOS inverter. Same
physical cell pex.json extracts as `ro_buf_pex`,
deliberately under a DIFFERENT cell name here: the
script writes raw/<name>.pex.spice and
reports/<name>.extract.json into the shared
layout/pex/ directory, so reusing the name would
make this descriptor's run overwrite artifacts
pex.json's own --check compares against (they were
produced by a different klt build -- see
layout/pdk.json's klt_version_pin comment on the
install churn). Two names, two artifact sets, two
independently checkable libraries.
sampler_tg_pex    layout/sampler_tg/ -- the transmission gate.
sampler_nand2_pex layout/sampler_nand2/ -- the rst_n-gated NAND2.
A deck includes ONE of the two libraries, never both: they each define
the inverter's parasitics, under different subcircuit names but from
the identical GDS.
cells[].ports is the DESIGN's own port order, as in pex.json. For the
two sampler leaves that order comes from each cell's own committed
micro-reference (layout/sampler_tg/sampler_tg.source.spice and
layout/sampler_nand2/sampler_nand2.source.spice), which is what those
cells' own `klt lvs` match is against -- design/xschem/sampler_dff.sch
is flat and has no sub-schematic symbol for either shape.
See pex.json's own _comment for the meaning of every other field, and
layout/pex/README.md for what the parasitic model does and does not
contain.
